title: Ei Ghar Ei Sansar
desc: After their parents' demise, a woman puts her life on hold to tend to her brothers, but later experiences hardships and betrayals from backstabbing her family.

title: Geet Sangeet
desc: Abandoning his affluent background, a man chases his musical dreams. However, he finds himself employed as a driver and becomes smitten with his boss's daughter.

title: Praner Swami
desc: A businessman unsuccessfully looks for a prospective bride for his grandson, Moti. Later, Moti marries a woman, Moyna, of his choice, but she catches the eye of his friend, who wants her for himself.

title: Pooja
desc: A maidservant witnesses the horrific tortures subjected to her employer's daughter by her in-laws. Eventually, she hatches a plot to infiltrate the house and rescue her mistress.
